title: Piercing Frame Solo #105 (일반 허리 컷 · P25 집중형 · 슬릭백 · 실버그레이 · 메이크업 뱀파이어다크 · 금속 황동 · 재질 단일(흑요암금) · 체형 크고 힘 있는 체형·매끈하게 둥근 배 · 배꼽 링)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman — pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, a cold, poised expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge antique-brass drop dangle hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, three smaller antique-brass rings, two thick antique-brass bars and a small antique-brass stud up to the top; one small antique-brass stud sits in the right ear; four antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small antique-brass rings pass through the left nostril and a thick antique-brass septum ring hangs below the nose; a antique-brass hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a antique-brass snake-bite ring beside it and a small antique-brass ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a antique-brass Medusa stud sits above the lips; a antique-brass labret stud and a small antique-brass ring sit on the chin; three small antique-brass studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. A antique-brass ring passes through the rim of her navel, the navel itself a deep dimple set in the smooth swell of her belly. All jewelry is real antique brass, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a tall, powerful frame with a smooth, softly rounded belly and a full bust.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the material reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it, down to the bottom of the frame, is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
